diagnosis: the recognised snapshot candidates are a sparse subset of the demo's packet stream, so their delta chain is not contiguous (outer sequence jumps of hundreds of packets). A faithful replay needs every packet in order, including the configstring/serverCommand records between snapshots.
conclusion: demo replay is not a shortcut; the useful parts of the demo remain the measured match-start configstrings and the decodable baseline playerState
